### New Members {#no-member}

Monthly signups show the number of new members joining Collaboratory, reflecting platform growth trends. The cumulative view illustrates total membership over time.

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false


ggplot(signups_monthly_filtered, aes(x = Month, y = Total_Signups)) +
  geom_line(color = "#00205C", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#00205C", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Member Signups",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),  # light horizontal gridlines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

signups_monthly_cumulative <- signups_monthly_filtered %>%
  arrange(Month) %>%
  mutate(Cumulative_Signups = cumsum(Total_Signups))

ggplot(signups_monthly_cumulative, aes(x = Month, y = Cumulative_Signups)) +
  geom_line(color = "#00205C", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#00205C", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Member Signups",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

### Longterm Retention {#long-ret}

Longterm retention measures the proportion of members who have logged in at least once every 90 days over the past 12 months, highlighting consistent participation. Currently, **`r long_term_retained_members`** out of **`r long_term_total_members` members** **(`r percentage_retained`)** does not meet this criterion, falling short of the target of **≥ 30%**.
